notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Lapis Lazuli Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Empowered Autogenerator.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
